title: Multi-Armed Bandits
oneLine: The simplest RL problem: balance exploring options against exploiting the best.

paras: A bandit faces several actions with unknown payoffs and must learn which is best while earning reward. Pull the current best too eagerly and you may never discover a better one; explore too much and you waste pulls. Strategies like epsilon-greedy and UCB formalize this explore-exploit trade-off - the heart of all RL.
UCB picks the arm with the best optimistic estimate, favoring uncertain arms:
sections.texNote: The bonus term shrinks as an arm is tried more, so exploration self-regulates.

sections.caption: Optimism in the face of uncertainty.

takeaways: Epsilon-greedy explores at random; UCB explores by uncertainty.
Every RL method inherits this tension.
